text: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(p.product_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_drink_item = 1 THEN p.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS beverage_revenue FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi JOIN (SELECT product_id, MAX(product_price) AS product_price, MAX(is_drink_item) AS is_drink_item FROM jaffle_shop.dev.products GROUP BY product_id) p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE LOWER(c.customer_name) = LOWER('Ryan byrd') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
